clarity.notes: All sections readable. Removed redundant gloss-divider after carousel. Form error feedback added. Hero card overlay contrast improved to 0.5/0.35.

hierarchy.notes: Display headings use negative tracking (-0.015em). Caps have 0.08em tracking. Section-title, hero-title, carousel-short-title all use proper display tracking.

typography.notes: Oranienbaum + Inter. Negative tracking on h1/h2 (≥32px), zero on h3/h4. Caps tracking at 0.06–0.1em across nav, labels, buttons.

motion.notes: Reduced motion query disables all animations (particles, gloss sweep, carousel, flip, shimmer, parallax, cursor glow). Per WCAG 2.2.2, animations stay under 5s loops.

brand.notes: Dark wood theme (#1c1714 bg, #c8a96e accent, #f5ede4 text). Gloss effects read as lacquer/varnish on timber. All interactive elements have :focus-visible, :active, :disabled states.
